title: Developer docs get a clearer map
summary:
A documentation day: clearer integration guides, more ways to copy or download the API reference, and a refreshed community catalog.

The API reference now shares per-concept Markdown with LLM-readable docs and new BYOP, CLI, and MCP Server guides. Navigation was reorganized, with page-aware copy controls, focused documentation slices, and JSON or YAML OpenAPI downloads.

The generated APIDOCS page now has a shorter introduction and links to the BYOP, CLI, and MCP Server guides instead of carrying its former endpoint overview and quick-start examples.

An automated refresh updated app catalog metrics and health checks, while the README’s Latest News now links to Helix AI.
